CrossMux 1.5.10 is a Smart Standby rendering and delivery performance hotfix.

## Fixed

- Render Chinese text with an installed CJK font instead of displaying missing-glyph boxes.
- Automatically prefer Microsoft YaHei on Windows and common CJK font families on Linux/macOS.
- Allow an explicit font file through `SmartStandby__FontPath` and a preferred family through `SmartStandby__FontFamily`.
- Encode dashboards as native four-level 2-bpp BMP files, reducing an 800×480 dashboard from about 1.15 MiB to about 96 KiB.
- Reuse the MQTT connection across pushes instead of reconnecting for every render.

## Configuration

Windows normally needs no font configuration. For a custom font:

```bat
set "SmartStandby__FontPath=C:\Windows\Fonts\msyh.ttc"
```

Linux servers should install a CJK font or configure an absolute TTF/TTC/OTF path.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/sunkejava/crossmux/compare/1.5.9...1.5.10
